message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as the cover for Tempo magazine, dated September 28-October 4, 2020. The masthead "TEMPO" is centered in large, black serif letters at the top. Below it, the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in smaller black block letters.

The illustration features several human figures in a row. Four figures wear white, full-body protective suits with yellow helmets and transparent face shields covering green masks. One figure, positioned slightly forward and to the right, wears a grey short-sleeved shirt, a tan bucket hat, dark sunglasses, and a black face mask. He holds a black walkie-talkie and has a brown holster with a pistol grip tucked into his waistband. 

White text on the lower left reads "MAIN INTEL COVID-19." Below this, a paragraph begins with "Tes usap virus corona yang digelar Badan Intelijen Negara menuai masalah." 

At the top left, white text reads "NESTAPA UMALULU AKIBAT PABRIK TEBU." At the top right, white text reads "KEMBANG-KEMPIS ASET NEGARA." A red vertical bar runs down the left edge, and a horizontal red bar is at the bottom, containing a barcode and price information "RP 45.000."
